- **Google Photos import from a folder works on every server (FL-1477):** every server now has a built-in Imports folder, so the folder import from 1.2.17 appears without any extra setup. Advanced shows where the folder is on your computer, with Copy, and administrators can choose it from the start dialog.
- **New photos are processed first (FL-1478):** photos from an upload, import, shared link or folder scan now go ahead of the older job backlog, so a finished import gets its thumbnails and details right away. Activity reads "180 photos from Google Photos" instead of a computer upload.
- **Manager has a Containers screen (FL-1476):** edit each container's settings, folders and limits in one place, with suggestions for your server's cores, memory and graphics card. Manager reviews every change and which containers restart before saving, and offers to keep edits made in Docker or Unraid.
- **Clearer Manager Overview, Storage, Backups and Updates (FL-1476):** Overview opens with what needs you, worst first. Storage shows how full each drive is, Backups opens with your last recovery point and warns when backups share the photos' drive, and Updates shows the version that's ready with its notes.
